name: – Marcos Ros Sempere – § 6 – Am 2
title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text: 6. Stresses the key roles that media literacy and digital learning play in empowering users to navigate the digital environment; stresses that the acquisition of these skills is first and foremost the responsibility of parents and legal guardians as provided for in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, followed by the school system – the organisation of which falls to the Member States – and not a lifelong process supervised by EU institutions; warns against an overly broad interpretation of this oversight, which would make the EU an omnipresent actor in the education of citizens far beyond the scope of its powers; recalls that subsidiarity is not an optional principle and that education remains a national competence;
